public_source.release_semantics: Retrospective public audit package. Git object identity binds the released bytes, not original paper-time execution or provider-side run identity.

eval_task_manifest.semantics: 50 explicit game_idx/task_name rows across ten families, five held-out tasks per family.

eval_trajectories.semantics: Packed turn-by-turn evaluated episodes according to repository documentation.

per_task_results.observed_row_semantics: Rows include arm/method/checkpoint/backbone, task identity, reward/final_score/success, memory_snapshot metadata, and explicit error/skipped rows without task_name.

denominator_semantics.published_eval_table: Shows each main row as 50 tasks and success-rate percent using denominator 50.
denominator_semantics.arms_csv: Carries both n_tasks and n_valid; e.g. LangMem valid rows are 44,44,43,42 at N100..400.
denominator_semantics.verifier_loader: Drops rows with missing task marker, error, or skipped, therefore aggregates n_valid.
denominator_semantics.risk: A success-count check can pass while a displayed rate uses a different denominator.

coverage_findings: ScienceWorld CHECKS registers trend_8methods.csv and eval_8methods_success_and_rawscore.csv only; baseline_gpt_20fam.csv is omitted.
sciworld_trend maps only four win-count columns; CA z, CA p and raw slope columns are not checked.
sciworld_eval maps only success-count; task count, displayed success-rate, raw mean, full-score count and negative-score count are not checked.
raw_k16 is omitted from the sciworld_eval method mapping, so that published row yields no check.
The final 'reproduced X cells' count increments only for mapper-emitted checks, not against an independent inventory of all publication data cells.
The test asserts verifier exit status and '0 mismatched' but does not assert coverage closure.
verifier_coverage_audit.interpretation: The public CI attests that 675 mapper-defined checks match the released raw rows. It does not mechanically establish that every numeric value in every published CSV was checked.

ci.workflow_semantics: Both CPU gates run pytest and results/verify_numbers.py; the separate AgentGym plugin failure does not negate the successful arithmetic checks.
ci.scope_caution: Independent GitHub-hosted CI is execution attestation for the verifier at the retrospective release revision, not for the original hosted-model evaluation runs.

source_and_environment_binding.important_limitation: Repository documentation explicitly warns that reasoning-model runs remain nondeterministic at temperature 0.

residual_gaps: per-step memory-build trace is not in the ScienceWorld archive
server logs are not in the archive
Letta Postgres dumps are not in the archive
provider-side randomness/run identity and original execution-time nonrepudiation are not bound by the retrospective Git release
verifier coverage is incomplete for the full ScienceWorld published numeric table surface

phase1_assessment.static_success_count_audit: Strong scope-limited evidence: immutable rows and published success-count fields can be checked without model execution, hosted compute, optional quota or incremental monetary cost. Do not generalize this to every table field or full causal construction replay.

mnemo_final_scope.finding: Historical Build/Test/Clippy red status is reconstructable as an unrelated native-workspace link problem involving the WASM mnemo-golem-wit crate; it is not benchmark-specific evidence. Raw historical Actions logs now return 410 Gone. Security Audit remains separate/unresolved. Complete merge-tree inspection still finds no exact generated-input/ordered receiver-output/same-path audit transcript for the Auto-Dreamer-style benchmark, so protocol-066 continues to fail for full static replay.
mnemo_final_scope.repeat_policy: Do not revisit unless the public surface changes.
